insert.beat_text: Naruto stops. He walks to a drawer, pulls out an old letter filed under S, and lays the two side by side.
Boss, you said the old one signs like he's stabbing the page.
He did. He pressed so hard the brush split. This man doesn't press at all.

Same name, same seat, same wax. One signature stabs the page. The other flows like water. A man can change his face. He doesn't change his hand by accident.

He's dead. The Kazekage's dead, and somebody's signing in his place.

He takes it to Kakashi first. Kakashi reads both letters for a long minute, which for Kakashi is a very long time.
The Third Hokage studies the two signatures for a long time. Then he lowers his pipe.

stamp.label: CANON
stamp.note: Late to the Chunin final, too.

insert.beat_text: The Sand kid asked about Sasuke's match. The proctor showed him the postponement form. Filed three days ago.
Whose handwriting?
Nobody can disqualify a boy who has been officially delayed. Naruto filed the form before anyone knew they'd need it. That's what a clerk is for.
There's a leave slip, though. One ANBU captain, signed out for the night. Look who countersigned it.
A leave slip for the night the Uchiha clan died. And at the bottom, in a hand he has seen across a council table, one countersignature.
Boss. It says Danzo.

captions.text: Seven failures. Seven smiles.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Someone is failing the Chunin Exam on purpose, and a twelve year old filing clerk just noticed.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto Uzumaki reads whatever his clones learn.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He's emptied the archive and built a bridge. He does not get stronger. He gets to read first.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. This guy's failed the exam seven times.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Seven? Nobody's that bad at anything. Pull his file.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Kabuto Yakushi.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Seven failed exams, one friendly smile, and in canon, every single failure is on purpose.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kabuto's file is thin and spotless.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A clean record, a kind face, and a photograph where he smiles like he knows where the camera is hidden.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss, he's polite in every single report. Nobody's polite in every single report.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Everybody gets one complaint. Iruka's got eleven. I've got a whole shelf.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: And Kabuto has none.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Then let's go say hello.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Registration day.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The exam hall smells of nerves and floor wax, and near the door a young man in round glasses is handing out cards like a shopkeeper.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: First time? Don't be shy. I'm Kabuto Yakushi.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: I've failed this exam seven times, so I know where all the mistakes are.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: These are info cards. Every genin in the village, every mission, every stat.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: Take a look. They're free.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: Show me mine.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Sasuke Uchiha. Sharingan, clean record, no wounds worth a note.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: And Naruto Uzumaki. Oh, this one's easy.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: Kabuto turns the card around for half a second. Naruto reads it twice.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Shadow clones, never more than ten at a time. Has slept nineteen hours straight. Twice.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: That isn't in any file. Naruto would know. He filed every file.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Good luck in there, Naruto. Try not to collapse.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: Hn. He's too friendly. I don't like it.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Wow. We agree. Somebody mark the date.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Boss. Maybe he guessed.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Nobody guesses nineteen hours.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He doesn't go home.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He goes straight up the Hokage tower, past two startled guards, and he doesn't knock.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Old man. There's a genin in the exam with cards that know things.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I've read your archive, every shelf. He knows things that aren't in it.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Kabuto Yakushi. Seven attempts and not one complaint. Hm.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Somebody who's very good at not being in the paperwork. That's who.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Then we don't throw him out. A spy we can see is a spy we can read.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: The old man's left hand forms a cross seal on the desk.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He doesn't notice. Naruto does. He files that away for later.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The written exam. Two hundred genin, a wall clock, and chunin along every wall.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: At the front stands Ibiki Morino, who has never once been called friendly.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ten questions. The tenth comes last. Get caught cheating and you lose points.
captions.speaker: IBIKI

captions.text: Get caught enough and you lose the exam.
captions.speaker: IBIKI

captions.text: Nine questions on the page. Not one a genin could answer.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto reads number five and nearly laughs. It isn't a question. It's a dare.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto, why aren't you writing anything?
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: I'm working. Quietly. Mostly.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: So the clerk in him stops reading the paper and starts reading the room.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Every chunin has a clipboard. Every clipboard has a column. Every column is a name.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: They're not grading the paper. They're grading us.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: The first Chunin exam tests information gathering.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, you were supposed to cheat. You just weren't supposed to get caught.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto doesn't cheat. He does something sneakier.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A clone, transformed into a pencil, rolls quietly under Kabuto's desk.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. I'm a pencil. I have never been so humiliated.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Kabuto's copying the girl two rows ahead.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: He's not even looking down. Nobody's caught him.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Good. Write all of it down.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Then Ibiki asks the tenth question. Leave now and fail with your team, or stay and risk never being a chunin again.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Half the room walks out. Naruto stays.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: I'm not going anywhere. I've never once left before the last page.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Everyone who stayed passes. Uzumaki, your paper is blank.
captions.speaker: IBIKI

captions.text: Yeah. That isn't the exam. This is.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Four pages. Every cheater by row and method, and one name circled three times.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ibiki reads it standing up.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kid, you handed me a report instead of an exam.
captions.speaker: IBIKI

captions.text: Isn't that the same thing?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Today it is.
captions.speaker: IBIKI

captions.text: Across the hall, Kabuto's smile doesn't move.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: But for the first time, someone in the room is writing down exactly why.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The second exam is the Forest of Death.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Five days, one scroll each, a wall of trees, and Anko Mitarashi, who loves her job far too much.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Welcome to the Forest of Death! Sign the waiver.
captions.speaker: ANKO

captions.text: If you die, don't blame me. Blame the tigers.
captions.speaker: ANKO

captions.text: Is it too late to pick a smaller forest?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Yes! The gate opens in five minutes!
captions.speaker: ANKO

captions.text: The night before, Naruto knocked on one more door.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Anko Mitarashi opened it with a dango stick in her teeth.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: I read your file. And your old teacher's.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: If anyone from the Grass shows up in that forest, don't be the last person to find out.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Where did you get that name, kid?
captions.speaker: ANKO

captions.text: Unclassified shelf, filed under O. It's not a secret. Nobody just wanted to read it.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Anko doesn't say thank you. She does something more useful.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: She puts four ANBU on the tower roof and swallows the dango stick whole.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then the gate opens. The Second Hokage invented the Shadow Clone Jutsu for scouting, and Naruto finally uses it that way.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Two hundred clones, two hundred trees, ten at a time.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss, tree forty. A snake the size of a bus, eating a boar. Not ours.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Boss, a tiger's sitting on a team from Rain.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The team's fine. The tiger looks confused.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Mark both. We go west.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Boss, west has a lake. There's a very large frog in it.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Is it friendly?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It's eating the tiger. I'd say no.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Okay. South of the frog, then.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Why are we walking in a circle?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: It's not a circle. It's around the bad bit.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: What bad bit?
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Every bad bit. I've got a map. It's in my head, and my head is in two hundred trees.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: This feels like cheating.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: It's called scouting. A guy invented it. Look him up.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Boss. Grass team, sector eleven. Three genin. Two of them walk like genin.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: And the third one?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: His feet don't make a sound. The leaves don't move.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: And his eyes are yellow. He blinked sideways.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Below, the Grass team stops.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The third genin tilts his head and looks up into the canopy, at two hundred trees and one clone that looks right back.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Strange. The forest feels like it's counting us.
captions.speaker: OROCHIMARU

captions.text: Naruto remembers page forty of an old file.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A missing nin, a yellow gaze, a student who learned everything and kept the wrong parts.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Orochimaru.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He pops a messenger clone.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It runs, one branch every half second, straight to the tower where Anko is waiting.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Grass team, sector eleven! Yellow eyes! The boss says do not engage!
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Understood. Nobody goes near the Grass team.
captions.speaker: ANKO

captions.text: Tell him thank you. And tell him I said it quietly.
captions.speaker: ANKO

captions.text: By the time her squad reaches sector eleven, the Grass team is gone.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A headband sits folded on a branch, and that's all.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Team Seven never meets Orochimaru. Nobody bites Sasuke's neck.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, this is the afternoon that changes him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: They reach the tower on day three with both scrolls and not a scratch.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then two hundred trees of tiredness arrive at once, and Naruto falls asleep standing up.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto? Naruto! He's asleep. Standing up.
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Leave him. He earned it.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: The month before the final. Sasuke Uchiha has a problem, and the problem is orange.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto keeps getting ahead of him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: How many hours do you train?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Two thousand a day. Sort of. It's mostly clones. I mostly nap.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: That isn't fair.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: No. It's maths, ya know.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Sasuke's goal is older than the exam, older than Team Seven, older than his headband.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Falling behind the dead last was never part of it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: I need to be stronger. Nothing else matters. Not you, not the exam.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Okay. Then use me.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: What did you say?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Forty sparring partners, whenever you want them.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: And every report ever filed on the Sharingan. Who beat it. Who lost to it. How.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It's the only way Naruto knows to say I'm on your side.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He doesn't say it out loud. He's a filing clerk. He files it.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Why would you help me?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Nobody ever trained with me. So I know exactly what it's worth.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Fine. Forty. Start now.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Forty Narutos, ten at a time.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sasuke's Sharingan catches every pattern, so Naruto shows it nothing twice.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ow! He hit me! Boss, he hit me!
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: I know. I felt it.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Why do you keep flinching?
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Because I'm the one who gets hit.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Again. Faster this time.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Boss, I don't want to be next.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: You're a clone. You're always next.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: The Sharingan reads motion. The reports read habit.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: By week three, Sasuke has lost to the same boy twelve different ways and learned something from every one.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi shows up three hours late to a session he didn't schedule.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He's always late. Every single time.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: I see someone's been reading about me.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: About the Sharingan.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Same thing.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Can I train with you two as well?
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: Sure! I've got a file on chakra control. It's mostly about you.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Why is there a file about me?
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: You're really good at it. I read it for fun.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Sasuke doesn't say thank you. At sundown he says, same time tomorrow.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: From an Uchiha, that's a speech.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A week before the final, a clone files a hospital incident report. Patient, Rock Lee.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Cause of injury, sand. Eleven witnesses. None of them can say how it moved.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. The sand moved before he was hit. It guarded him.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: And the Sand genin's chart says nobody's ever seen him sleep.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Never sleeps. Huh.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He knows one other person who sleeps badly.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: That night Naruto closes his eyes and walks down into the dark, past the bars, to ask the only expert in the village.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hey, fox. You awake?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Always, brat. Your snoring echoes.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: I don't snore.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: You do. I have twelve years of data, brat.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: That Sand kid. The sand that moves on its own. Is that like you?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Shukaku. A raccoon dog with a sand fixation and no manners.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: That raccoon never sleeps because his cage is badly made.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: What's a badly made cage?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: A cheap lock. A maker in a hurry, or afraid.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: The bars don't hold, so the prisoner never rests, and neither does the boy.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: Kurama is quiet for a long moment.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It's the same quiet as a clone reading to him in the dark.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Mine was made well. By a man who loved the boy it was for. I hate that I know that.
captions.speaker: KURAMA

captions.text: The next night Naruto finds Gaara on a rooftop at the edge of the village.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sand curls around his feet like a pet that has learned not to be loved.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Leave. Everyone who comes this close dies. It's the only reason anyone comes.
captions.speaker: GAARA

captions.text: I'm not here to fight. I read the report on Lee. The sand moves before you do.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It protects me.
captions.speaker: GAARA

captions.text: From who?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Everyone.
captions.speaker: GAARA

captions.text: You don't sleep, do you? Because if you sleep, he takes the wheel.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: The sand stops moving. For the first time since Naruto arrived, Gaara looks at him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Who told you that?
captions.speaker: GAARA

captions.text: Nobody. Mine talks too. Mine just reads over my shoulder.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Then you're lying, or you're the same as me.
captions.speaker: GAARA

captions.text: I got lucky. People walked toward me.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Late, but they walked. You got a cage with a bad lock.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: That doesn't make you the monster. It means whoever built it was in a hurry.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Stop talking.
captions.speaker: GAARA

captions.text: Okay. I can't fix it. I'm not gonna pretend I can.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I just wanted someone to say it out loud.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It cures nothing. Gaara doesn't thank him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: But the sand that has moved for him every night for years hesitates for one second, and then it stays still.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto walks home with no plan for this one.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: For the first time in a month, he has nothing filed.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The month ends at the mail desk. One envelope from the Hidden Sand, sealed in wax.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It confirms the Kazekage's seat at the Chunin final.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss, standard form. He's coming. He wants the good chair.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Read me the signature.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Soft. Round. Every downstroke curves. Looks like a swan wrote it.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Naruto stops.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He walks to a drawer, pulls out an old letter filed under S, and lays the two side by side.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss, you said the old one signs like he's stabbing the page.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: He did. He pressed so hard the brush split. This man doesn't press at all.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Same name, same seat, same wax. One signature stabs the page. The other flows like water.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A man can change his face. He doesn't change his hand by accident.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He's dead. The Kazekage's dead, and somebody's signing in his place.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: In canon, he's right.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Orochimaru killed the Fourth Kazekage and took his chair, and the Sand never knew.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. That's a head of state.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: I know. That's the problem.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Should we tell somebody?
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: We're going to tell everybody. Nobody's going to listen.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He takes it to Kakashi first.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kakashi reads both letters for a long minute, which for Kakashi is a very long time.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto. I like you. But a signature isn't a body.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: It's the last habit a body keeps. And this one's a swan.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: It's a lovely theory. Nobody will believe it.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: If I'm right, you'll have to explain it to the council.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: And if you're wrong, I'll have to explain you.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: He's right. The council hears about it in eleven minutes and laughs for twelve.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Only one elder doesn't.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A boy who reads handwriting. Keep him close, Hiruzen.
captions.speaker: DANZO

captions.text: I intend to.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Nobody believes a filing clerk about a head of state.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Nobody except the old man who hired him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Show me.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: The Third Hokage studies the two signatures for a long time.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then he lowers his pipe.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: I taught that hand its letters. The neatest brush in my class.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Never pressed hard on anything, even then.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: You know who it is.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: I know who I'm afraid it is. That isn't the same thing.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: He'll sit beside you.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: In front of ten thousand people, in the best seat in the stadium.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Protocol. The Hokage sits beside the Kazekage. If I don't, he knows.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Old man. Why are you the one sitting in that chair?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: The old man's left hand forms a cross seal on the desk.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He still hasn't noticed. Naruto has been noticing for a month.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Who said it would be me?
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: The Chunin final.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ten thousand seats, every one full, and a village that believes the worst thing today can bring is a bad match.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sasuke isn't here. Neither is Kakashi.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, both arrive late to the final, and the match is nearly forfeited.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. I'm a filing box in the exam office. A proctor just put his coffee on me.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The Sand kid asked about Sasuke's match.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The proctor showed him the postponement form. Filed three days ago.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Whose handwriting?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Yours, Boss. Obviously.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Nobody can disqualify a boy who has been officially delayed.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Naruto filed the form before anyone knew they'd need it. That's what a clerk is for.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sorry we're late. A black cat crossed my path.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: He made us take the long way around the whole village.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: Right on time. Technically.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Above them, in the Kage's box, the Hokage and the Kazekage sit side by side.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Hokage smokes his pipe. The Kazekage smiles at nothing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Then the feathers fall. White, soft, drifting over the stands like snow.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In ten seconds, ten thousand people are asleep.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Kabuto is the only one still standing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The ANBU assigned to watch him are asleep in the third row, and so is Naruto.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The plan has a hole, and it's exactly the shape of an ANBU squad. Ten squads were meant to hold the gates.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: All ten are dreaming, and Sound ninja are already coming over the walls.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: On the roof, four violet flames go up, four Sound ninja take their corners, and a dome closes over the Kage's box.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Kazekage removes his hat.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hello, Sensei. It's been so long. You've grown old.
captions.speaker: OROCHIMARU

captions.text: So have you, Orochimaru. You used to knock.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: This barrier holds until one of us stops breathing. I'd hoped it would be you.
captions.speaker: OROCHIMARU

captions.text: I'm sure you did.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: The Third Hokage can use shadow clones, and he's been using one all afternoon.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It pops.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: On the next rooftop, the real Hokage feels the whole conversation arrive at once.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Jiraiya stands on his left. Four ANBU wait behind him. They've been there since dawn.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And Orochimaru is standing alone inside his own barrier.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: It holds until someone stops breathing. There's nobody in it but him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Orochimaru. You always did build a lovely cage.
captions.speaker: JIRAIYA

captions.text: Your barrier is excellent. But a boy read your handwriting.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: A boy? Sensei, since when do you take advice from clerks?
captions.speaker: OROCHIMARU

captions.text: Since one of them started being right.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: It should end there.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: But Naruto's plan needed somebody awake in the stands, and every awake person in it is a filing box.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss! Boss, wake up! Boss!
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The box can't shout through a genjutsu. But it remembers rule three.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: A clone that gets hit pops, and he keeps the hit. The only way to hit a sleeping boy is to hit someone else.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The box drops its disguise, walks out into the open,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: and lets a Sound ninja put a kunai in its shoulder.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ow. Okay. That one's mine.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: The clone pops.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In the stands, Naruto jolts awake with a stab in his shoulder and a minute of someone else's afternoon.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: That hurts. Okay. Okay. Everybody's asleep.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Forty clones is four batches. That's a four hour headache later. Fine. Fine.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Impressive. Nobody wakes up from that. Not even jonin.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: One of me got stabbed. It's a long story.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: You're a very strange boy, Naruto.
captions.speaker: KABUTO

captions.text: He can't wake ten thousand people. But he can wake forty.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Every genjutsu report he ever filed says the same thing. Pain breaks it. So forty Narutos run the rows.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sorry! Emergency! Sorry! Sorry!
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Naruto? Did you just slap me?
captions.speaker: IRUKA

captions.text: Sorry, sensei! It was an emergency!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Then go! I'll take the left side!
captions.speaker: IRUKA

captions.text: Naruto, you slapped me!
captions.speaker: SAKURA

captions.text: You were asleep! It counts as medicine!
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Kabuto doesn't fight a boy with forty witnesses. He's gone before the third slap.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Ten squads wake up angry and head for the gates,
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: and two late arrivals head for them faster.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Sasuke, east gate. I'll take the west one.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: Try not to be late.
captions.speaker: SASUKE

captions.text: I'm already here. Give me some credit.
captions.speaker: KAKASHI

captions.text: And in the middle of the arena, Gaara stands alone. The sand is up. It isn't moving.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The man in the white hat gave the order. He said he was my father.
captions.speaker: GAARA

captions.text: He wasn't. I've got the handwriting. I'm sorry.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Then who has been giving the orders?
captions.speaker: GAARA

captions.text: Naruto doesn't have an answer the boy would believe. The sand rises, then lowers. It cures nothing.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: But it doesn't go for Naruto, and it doesn't go for the village. After a while, Gaara just leaves.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: On the roof, the Sound Four have to drop their own barrier to let their master out.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The moment it falls, Orochimaru is fighting his old teacher and his old teammate at once. He loses ground every minute.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Who wrote this plan, Sensei? It isn't yours. It's far too tidy.
captions.speaker: OROCHIMARU

captions.text: A clerk.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Orochimaru does what he has always done when a plan goes wrong. He leaves. He keeps his arms.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Hiruzen lets him go, because the village needs its Hokage more than it needs a grudge.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: The Sand shinobi hold their line for an hour. Then word spreads that the Kazekage's chair held a stranger, and they have no reason left to be here.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: By dusk, the invasion is over. It lasted one afternoon.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: In canon, the Third Hokage dies on that roof.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Tonight he's in a hospital bed with a stitched shoulder, a burned sleeve, and strong opinions about the soup.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Old man. You're alive.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: So I'm told. I'd like it noted that I planned this.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: You did not. I planned this.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Then I'd like it noted that I approved it.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Naruto. Tell the village I'm fine. Tell them the soup is a crime.
captions.speaker: HIRUZEN

captions.text: Naruto's reward is paperwork. The aftermath of the invasion.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Eleven thousand pages, one night, forty clones.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He doesn't mind. Paper is the only thing in this village that has never lied to him.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: At two in the morning, it does. A gap on the shelf marked Uchiha.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Not a missing file. A missing order.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. The night the Uchiha clan died.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: There's no mission order for it. Nothing at all.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Somebody gave an order. Somebody always gives an order.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: There's a leave slip, though.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: One ANBU captain, signed out for the night. Look who countersigned it.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: A leave slip for the night the Uchiha clan died.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: And at the bottom, in a hand he has seen across a council table, one countersignature.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: Boss. It says Danzo.
captions.speaker: CLONE

captions.text: Don't say it twice.
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: He looks up. Naruto knows everyone in this village by their footsteps.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: He didn't hear these.
captions.speaker: NARRATOR

captions.text: How long have you been standing there?
captions.speaker: NARUTO

captions.text: Long enough.
captions.speaker: SASUKE
